profile_text.body:
AeroVironment Inc describes itself as a leading manufacturer of Unmanned Aircraft Systems, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles, Loitering Munition Systems, and Unmanned Ground Vehicles used for surveillance and reconnaissance by the United States Military, U.S. allies, and commercial industries. The company also says it manufactures High-Altitude Pseudo-Satellites.

Its MacCready Works group is described as an advanced development unit inspired by Dr. Paul B. MacCready, Jr., with engineers, roboticists, and AI researchers designing next-generation robotic systems across air, land, and sea. The company says the group follows a method of building fast, testing relentlessly, and deploying advantage.

AeroVironment is a public company headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, with ticker AVAV and SEC CIK number 0001368622. Virginia records show 152 legal exposure entries for the company.
